about.text: an aged, hard cheese with a lower butterfat percentage than other Gouda-style cheeses.

sources.text: Aged Gouda-style from Friesland, under 48% fat in dry matter; Wikipedia says 'typically aged four or more years' (many producers sell it younger); rind type not stated
